summary: [Web] SLD (one-line diagram) PDF export: at a left-side terminal, the "TO …" name tag of a hidden connection is printed under the asset symbol, so the start of the name is hidden
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
On the one-line diagram (SLD) a connection line can be hidden to keep the drawing tidy.
Each end of a hidden connection then shows a small name tag that says where the line goes, for example "TO QA-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)".
On screen the tag is drawn beside the asset, not over it.
When the diagram is exported to PDF, a tag on the LEFT side of an asset is printed starting in the middle of the asset's black symbol and running to the right.
So the first letters are hidden under the symbol: the tag reads "-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)" instead of "TO QA-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)".
The tag at the other end of the same connection prints fine.
It matters because the PDF is what customers and field crews print and use; a cut-off tag makes it hard to tell where the hidden connection goes.
In the PDF a left-side tag should point away from the asset (to the left), as it does on screen, so the whole name can be read.

!ZP-4869-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!
!ZP-4869-expected-mockup-v2.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
In the exported PDF the tag at the junction box's left terminal starts inside the black "JB" symbol and runs to the right, so "TO QA" is hidden and only "-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)" can be read.

h3. Expected result
At a left-side terminal the PDF draws the tag to the left of the symbol, away from it (as the screen does), so the whole text "TO QA-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)" can be read.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / login: Project Manager, abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com
* Site: "QA-DEMO ZP-4800 SLD canvas v2.4 (delete me)" (QA test site, id 363d5350-b42d-4e48-850f-b9f72d27ea08)
* SLD page: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds (pick the site in *Current site* first; the Project Manager's menu has no SLD item, so open the page with this link)
* Hidden connection "QA-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)" → "QA-DEMO 4799 JBOX (delete me)", id 30fcae76-8a1f-4530-a739-6199d9bf8471 (SRC CB bottom terminal → JBOX left terminal)
* Asset "QA-DEMO 4799 JBOX (delete me)": https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/525225bf-4cf4-4c84-adcf-e270064425a3
* Export settings: Export Entire SLD, paper ARCH-D (default), text labels on; file "sld-export-2026-10-14.pdf"
* Found 13 Oct 2026 on QA build index-C14cwR0U.js. Re-checked 14 Oct 2026 with fresh exports on index-G6uKkjPx.js and index-D-HsTlcR.js: still reproduces.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com. In *Current site* pick "QA-DEMO ZP-4800 SLD canvas v2.4 (delete me)", then open the SLD page https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds . The connection SRC CB → JBOX is hidden. On the canvas its tag at the JBOX left terminal sits to the LEFT of the symbol, so nothing covers it (the screen shortens long names with "…"). (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4869-1-canvas-tag-left-of-symbol.png|width=720!
2. Click *Export* (bottom toolbar), then *Export PDF*. (Screenshot 2)
!5-2-export-menu-export-pdf.png|width=720!
3. In the *Export PDF* window click *Export Entire SLD* (Screenshot 3), keep the defaults (ARCH-D) and click *Generate PDF* (Screenshot 3b). The PDF downloads after about 20 seconds.
!5-3-export-pdf-dialog.png|width=720!
!5-3b-export-pdf-options.png|width=720!
4. Open the PDF and zoom to QA-DEMO 4799 JBOX. The tag starts inside the black symbol and runs right, so "TO QA" is hidden and it reads "-DEMO 4591 SRC CB (delete me)". (Screenshot 4)
!ZP-4869-4-pdf-jbox-tag-under-symbol.png|width=720!
5. Control, same PDF: at the other end (SRC CB, bottom terminal) the tag "TO QA-DEMO 4799 JBOX (delete me)" is clear of the symbol and readable. Only the left-terminal tag is covered. (Screenshot 5)
!ZP-4869-5-pdf-control-other-end-readable.png|width=720!

h3. Notes for the developer
* PDF export (backend): the left-terminal tag starts at the middle of the JBOX symbol and runs right, so its first characters are drawn under the filled symbol. The bottom-terminal tag at the other end is centred under its terminal and is fine. The canvas already draws left-terminal tags to the left.
* The UI export request is {{POST /api/sld/export/pdf/start}} with arch_size arch-d, omit_text false and engineering_mode true.
* Same feature as ZP-4800 (hide / show connections). No existing ticket: ZP-3839 is about label size, and the "PDF parity" in ZP-4803 covers dual offsets and merged terminals, not hidden-connection tags.

summary: [Web] Form builder preview (Web View): fields that list the company's users show no names, so form authors cannot try them (Test Equipment fields work)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
Form authors build forms in *Builder › Forms* and check them in the "Web View" preview before the forms are used on work orders.
A form field can take its choices from a list, for example the company's test equipment or the company's users ("pick the technician").
In the preview, fields that use the users list show no names at all, only "Select...".
In the same preview, a field that uses the Test Equipment list does show its 10 items, so the preview can load lists; only the users list is missing.
The same users field works inside a real work order, so filled-in forms are not affected.
Today only our QA test form uses a users list (it was made through the API), so the impact is small (Low).
It matters because once users-list fields are used, authors cannot check how they look or behave before they publish the form.
The preview should list the users, the same as a real work order does.

!ZP-4870-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!
!ZP-4870-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
In Web View, "S1 Users select (dataset, 246 rows)" opens with only "Select...", "M1 Users multiselect (dataset)" opens with no options, and "M3 Users multiselect checkbox_list display (dataset)" shows no boxes at all. "S2 Test equipment select (dataset)" in the same preview lists its 10 items (below the empty "Select..." line).

h3. Expected result
Users-list fields show the company's users in Web View, the same as in a real work order and the same way Test Equipment fields already do.

summary: [Web] Work order Forms tab: two different forms that have no form key are listed under one form's name, so users open the wrong form
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
A work order's Forms tab has a "Form Types" list on the left that groups the work order's forms by form.
It groups them by an internal "form key", and some forms have no key.
When a work order holds two different forms that both have no key, the list shows them under ONE name: the first form's name.
In our test work order three rows appear under "QA-DEMO ZP-4717 visible normalization", but two of them are really a different form, and clicking one opens that other form.
This is not only test data: on 14 Oct, 42 of the 660 forms on Acme QA have no key, and 35 of those are real (not QA-DEMO) forms.
It matters because users look for a form by its name, so they open or fill the wrong form, or cannot find the right one.
Each form should be listed under its own name.

!ZP-4871-key-highlighted.png|width=720!
!ZP-4871-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
"Form Types" shows ONE entry, "QA-DEMO ZP-4717 visible normalization (delete me)", with 3 rows. The 3 rows come from 2 different forms: the first "13N-H1-1" row opens "QA-DEMO ZP-4751 ZP-4753 dataset type-to-search (delete me)", not the form named in the list.

h3. Expected result
"Form Types" groups by the form itself (its id), not by its key. Forms without a key each show their own name and their own count, and are never merged under another form's name.

h3. Test data

* Role / login: Project Manager, abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (steps 1 to 3). Step 4 needs the Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com: a Project Manager has no *Builder* menu and gets "Access Denied" on the forms page.

summary: [Web] SKM import: importing an unchanged SKM export back changes the class of existing assets without any warning (12 of 94 on the test site, e.g. PDU → Panelboard, Lightning Arrester → Load)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
Engineers can export a site's equipment to an SKM file (for the SKM power-study software), change values there, and import the file back.
We exported a test site and imported the same file straight back, without changing anything.
The review screen says 94 assets will be updated, and the import would also change the class (equipment type) of 12 of them, for example PDU → Panelboard and Lightning Arrester → Load.
Nothing on the screen warns about this: the banner only says engineering values will be overwritten, and the class column (off to the right) shows only the new class, never the current one.
6 of the 12 are classes that the export's "READ THIS BEFORE IMPORTING" PDF lists as "exported as generic loads"; the other 6 (PDU, Other, MV Switch, Junction Box, Capacitor, Motor Starter) are not mentioned anywhere.
On 3 assets we confirmed that clicking Update really changes the class (they were put back the same day).
It matters because the class decides the asset's symbol, forms and maintenance plan, so a normal "export, fix a value, import back" round trip would quietly change equipment data on a customer site.
An unchanged file should change nothing, or the review should list each class change and let the user keep the current class.

!ZP-4876-key-highlighted.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The review of the unchanged file says "94 Updated" and *Update 94 assets*. The class chips (e.g. "Panelboard: 12", "Load: 9") and the "Class / subtype" column (visible only after scrolling the table to the right) show the class each asset will get. Compared with today's classes, 12 assets would get a different class (table in step 5). Nothing shows the current class or marks a change, and there is no "class will change" warning.

h3. Expected result
An unchanged round trip changes nothing. When an imported row matches an existing asset (by Alternate UID), the asset keeps its class, or the review lists every "class will change from X to Y" and lets the user keep the current class.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / login: Project Manager, abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com
* Site: "QA-DEMO ZP-4800 SLD canvas v2.4 (delete me)" (QA test site, id 363d5350-b42d-4e48-850f-b9f72d27ea08); SLD page https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/slds (open it with the link after picking the site; the Project Manager's menu has no SLD item), assets page https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets
* Example assets: QA G-SeriesCap https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/42e71131-76df-4a4b-9801-704528e46752 , QA G-MotorStarter https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/6d5983e2-7bf7-4e7a-8766-23f00e155b54 , QA G-PDU https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/a6921488-7464-4a06-b3e8-6b00a4c620f9 , QA G-Arrester https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/02ec9b8a-7ea9-43b9-92e3-4ea684c25b65
* Export file of 14 Oct: "skm_export_363d5350_2026-10-14_095009.zip" (holds the .xml and "READ THIS BEFORE IMPORTING.pdf"); the review pre-fills SKM project "skm_export_363d5350_2026-10-14_095009" (94 components)
* Found 13 Oct 2026 on QA build index-C14cwR0U.js. Re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on index-G6uKkjPx.js and index-D-HsTlcR.js: the same 12 class changes. With the full file QA only ran the review and clicked Cancel (nothing committed). The commit was proven on 13 Oct with a 4-asset cut of the export; the 3 changed assets were put back the same day (14 Oct check: Capacitor, Motor Starter, PDU).

h3. Steps to reproduce

Open *Site Data › Assets* and note the *Asset Class*: QA G-PDU = PDU, QA G-SeriesCap = Capacitor, QA G-MotorStarter = Motor Starter, QA G-Arrester = Lightning Arrester. (Screenshot 1)

They were put back the same day.
!ZP-4876-5-13oct-4-asset-file-review.png|width=720!
!ZP-4876-6-13oct-after-update-classes-changed.png|width=720!

h3. Notes for the developer
* Several EG classes share one SKM type (Pi, Bus, Load, MotorController). When a row matches an existing asset (Alternate UID), the importer writes its default class for that SKM type over the asset's class.
* The export zip's "READ THIS BEFORE IMPORTING.pdf" lists Motor Controller (3), Instrument Transformer, Lightning Arrester and Shunt Reactor under "Exported as generic loads", but nothing says that importing the file back turns those existing assets into Load.
* The preview call is {{POST /api/skm/import-xml/preview}}; each component has eg_class (new class) and alt_node_id (matched asset), so the review could compare eg_class with the asset's current class.
* Found while testing ZP-4603 (which passes); not caused by that ticket. Related: ZP-3836 (SKM round trip and Alternate UID matching), ZP-2689 (SKM export class mapping defaults), ZP-4854 (Bulk Edit round trip).

summary: [Web] Asset › Maintenance › Add Service History: a future "Last serviced" date shows a raw technical error instead of a plain message (and the date box allows future dates)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
On an asset's Maintenance tab, a user can add a past service to the asset's service history, for example "Cleaning on 10 Oct".
The "Last serviced" date box lets the user pick a date in the future.
When they click Save, the server correctly refuses the future date, but the window shows the raw technical reply: "API call failed: 400 - ..." with computer text (JSON), an internal field name and a code instead of a dash.
The user is not told in plain words what is wrong or what to do.
It matters because customers see an error that looks like the app is broken, and may not understand that only the date is wrong.
The date box should not offer future dates, and if one is still sent the window should show a short message such as "Last serviced can't be a future date. Pick today or an earlier date."

!ZP-4880-key-highlighted.png|width=720!
!ZP-4880-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

Video (recorded on asset FDR-Circuit Breaker-3): [^future_date_infrared.mov]

h3. Actual result
The date box accepts tomorrow's date and *Save* stays enabled. After *Save* the red box in the window shows exactly this (the dash appears as a code):
{noformat}
API call failed: 400 - { "error": "last_serviced_on cannot be in the future \u2014 it records work that has already happened", "success": false }
{noformat}
Nothing is saved (correct), but the message is the raw server reply.

h3. Expected result
* The date box does not allow dates after today (or turns red as soon as a future date is picked).
* If a future date is still sent, the window shows a short, plain message under the date, for example: *"Last serviced can't be a future date. Pick today or an earlier date."*
* Users never see "API call failed", the status code, JSON or field names.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / login: Project Manager, abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (customer user)
* Site: "QA-DEMO ZP-4800 SLD canvas v2.4 (delete me)" (QA test site)
* Asset "QA PNL1": https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/4b84bf4a-ad24-4c31-944d-5d65ba29a846
* Also reproduced as Super Admin (abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com) on asset "FDR-Circuit Breaker-3": https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/713ff57d-288d-47b3-b7b4-ef12958f0b9c (the asset in the video; a Project Manager gets "This asset link doesn't look right" there)
* Values: Service = Cleaning, Last serviced = tomorrow (15/10/2026 when re-checked on 14 Oct)
* Found 13 Oct 2026 on QA build index-C14cwR0U.js. Re-checked 14 Oct 2026 on index-G6uKkjPx.js and index-D-HsTlcR.js: still reproduces. Save returns 400, so nothing is stored.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com. In *Current site* choose "QA-DEMO ZP-4800 SLD canvas v2.4 (delete me)".
2. Go to *Site Data › Assets*, search "QA PNL1" and open it (https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/4b84bf4a-ad24-4c31-944d-5d65ba29a846).
3. Click the *Maintenance* tab. A small menu opens: choose *Maintenance*. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4880-1-maintenance-tab-menu.png|width=720!
4. On the right, under *SERVICE HISTORY*, click *+ Add record*. (Screenshot 2)
!ZP-4880-2-service-history-add-record.png|width=720!
5. In *Add Service History* pick Service = *Cleaning*, and in *Last serviced* pick tomorrow's date. The date box accepts it (future days are not blocked) and *Save* stays enabled. (Screenshot 3)
!ZP-4880-3-future-date-accepted.png|width=720!
6. Click *Save*. The red box shows the raw server error; nothing is saved. (Screenshot 4)
!ZP-4880-4-raw-error-after-save.png|width=720!

h3. Notes for the developer
* The server check is correct (future service dates are refused on purpose, see ZP-4045); only the way the error is shown is wrong.
* The *Last serviced* box is a plain date input with no max date: set max = today and map this 400 ({{PUT /api/asset-maintenance/node/<id>/history}}) to a field message.
* Same kind of issue as ZP-4730, ZP-4714 and ZP-4412 (raw "API call failed" text shown to users). The asset FDR-Circuit Breaker-3 is a Cable-class asset despite its name.

summary: [Web] SLD Issues list calls an Inverter and a Rectifier a "Transformer" ("no secondary winding voltage"): wrong, confusing wording
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
The one-line diagram (SLD) page has an Issues list that warns about missing engineering data.
For an Inverter and a Rectifier it says "Transformer without secondary voltage" and "This transformer has no secondary winding voltage set".
These assets are not transformers, so the message is confusing: users may think the asset has the wrong class or the check is broken.
The check itself is right: these assets do need a Secondary Voltage, and the user can set it in *Edit Asset*, which clears the warning.
So only the wording is wrong (Low).
The warning should name the real class and say what to fill in, for example "Inverter without output voltage on QA G-Inverter: set Secondary Voltage in Edit Asset". Transformers keep today's text.

!ZP-4882-key-highlighted.png|width=720!
!ZP-4882-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

h3. Actual result
The Issues list shows "Transformer without secondary voltage on QA G-Inverter" (also on QA G-Rectifier, QA INV1 and QA REC1), with the text "This transformer has no secondary winding voltage set…".

h3. Expected result
For inverters and rectifiers the warning uses the real class and the real field name, e.g. "Inverter without output voltage on QA G-Inverter: set Secondary Voltage in Edit Asset" and "Rectifier without output voltage on QA G-Rectifier: …". Transformers keep today's text.

3. Open asset QA G-Inverter: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/f556e269-32c7-4ae2-a8bb-7ec880304dae . Its *Asset Class* is *Inverter*. (Screenshot 2)

summary: [Web] Asset › Infrared › Add reading: the Technician list offers every user account of the company (246), and 57 of them are shown only as a full email address (outside email domains, egalvanic.com logins, old accounts)
desc:
h3. Simple explanation
On an asset's Infrared tab, "Add reading" records a meter reading and asks who the Technician was.
The Technician list offers every user account of the company (246 on Acme QA), not just the people who do field work.
57 of these accounts have no name and are shown only as their full email address, for example electric@spghvac.com, eric@bcesglobal.com, ryanm@hustonelectric.com, and egalvanic.com logins such as techniciansam@egalvanic.com.
Anyone who can add a reading, for example a Project Manager, can scroll through all these addresses.
All 246 accounts belong to Acme's own company. About 22 of them use outside business email domains (such as hustonelectric.com), and most of those are old accounts with no name, role or site.
It matters because email addresses are shown to people who do not need them, and a reading can be saved under a person who could never have taken it.
The list should offer only active people who can do the work on this site, shown by name.

!ZP-4893-key-highlighted-v2.png|width=720!
!ZP-4893-expected-mockup.png|width=720!

Video (recorded by the QA owner on asset Switchboard-1): [^email_show.mov]

h3. Actual result
The Technician list shows all 246 company user accounts (plus "None"). 57 of them are shown as their full email address (outside business domains, gmail.com addresses, egalvanic.com logins, test accounts), and any of them can be picked as the technician.

h3. Expected result
* The Technician list offers only people who can do the work: active users with a field / technician role who have access to this asset's site.
* People are shown by name. An email address is never used as the label (a user without a name is left out or shown as "Unnamed user").
* Customer portal contacts, accounts with no role or no site, and old seed accounts are not in the list.

h3. Test data
* Environment: https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai (QA)
* Role / login: Project Manager, abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com (customer user, not eGalvanic staff)
* Site: "QA-DEMO ZP-4800 SLD canvas v2.4 (delete me)" (QA test site)
* Asset "QA PNL1": https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/4b84bf4a-ad24-4c31-944d-5d65ba29a846
* The video was recorded with the QA owner's own login on asset "Switchboard-1": https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/2df51597-2e25-4932-9270-76df106cdede (it opens for the Super Admin abhiyant.singh+admin@egalvanic.com; the Project Manager gets "This asset link doesn't look right" because it is not on the PM's sites). The list is the same on every asset.
* Checked 14 Oct 2026 on QA build index-G6uKkjPx.js and again on index-D-HsTlcR.js: 246 users (all Acme company users), 57 of them shown as email addresses.

h3. Steps to reproduce
1. Sign in to https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai as the Project Manager abhiyant.singh+project@egalvanic.com and open asset "QA PNL1": https://acme.qa.egalvanic.ai/assets/4b84bf4a-ad24-4c31-944d-5d65ba29a846 . Click the *Maintenance* tab and choose *Infrared* in the small menu. Under *Readings* click *+ Add Reading*. The *Add reading* window opens with *Technician* = your own name. (Screenshot 1)
!ZP-4893-1-add-reading-technician-box.png|width=720!
2. Click the *Technician* box. After the names, accounts without a name are listed as their full email address, e.g. abhiyantsingh1@egalvanic.com, abhiyantsingh2@egalvanic.com. (Screenshot 2)
!ZP-4893-2-technician-list-emails-start.png|width=720!
3. Scroll down: more addresses, e.g. electric@spghvac.com, eric@bcesglobal.com, fallon.roznowski@teamuis.com, efitzgerald@kroon.ca, eric+acme@egalvanic.com. (Screenshot 3)
!ZP-4893-3-technician-list-more-emails.png|width=720!
4. Further down: ryanm@hustonelectric.com, scottn@hustonelectric.com, rashadcamp2001@gmail.com, techniciansam@egalvanic.com. (Screenshot 4)
!ZP-4893-4-technician-list-more-emails-2.png|width=720!
5. Press Escape and *Cancel*; nothing needs to be saved.

h3. Notes for the developer
* The list comes from {{GET /api/eg-form-sources/users}}: all 246 users of the signed-in user's company (fields id, is_current, name; 57 of the names are email addresses). All of them are Acme company users. About 22 use outside business email domains; most of those were created 29 Sep 2025 and have no name, role or sites (one is a real Acme Project Manager / Electrical Engineer).
* On 13 Oct the same endpoint returned the same 246 users to Facility Manager and Client Portal logins too.
* The same users list feeds the torque record "Technician" picker and EG form "Users" fields, so the same filter (active, field role, access to the asset's site, label by name) should apply there too.
* Related: ZP-4710 (asset readings), ZP-4867 (same users list).
